Now all I can do is recollect on our memories through this indistinguishable version of her.|audio = TheFinalActWave25-1.ogg|[[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]] on Wave 25 ([[The Narratorium]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Producer''' was a major boss that appeared in [[The Narratorium]], served as a mini-boss for the [[The Final Act Event]]. The '''Producer''' has four abilities: #The first ability is ''Clapboard'', which makes the '''Producer''' pull out a Clapper Board. After 3 seconds, this flashes the screen and slightly disorients the player, also stunning all towers in the map for 3.5 seconds and dealing 700 damage to units. #The second ability, ''Beam'', causes the '''Producer''' to pull out a film projector, attacking everything in a 120 degree arc with a range of 20, stunning towers for 4 seconds and dealing 1,600 damage to units. After throwing the projector, the impact causes the screen to flash, creating an afterimage of the player's screen. #The third ability is ''Summon''. In it, the '''Producer''' summons six [[Actor1 (Nil Zone)|Actor1s]] (75% chance), [[Actor2 (Nil Zone)|Actor2s]] (15% chance) and [[Actor3 (Nil Zone)|Actor3s]] (10% chance), which have a 60% to spawn with nothing, 20% chance to be [[Bloated]] and 20% chance to have [[Health Regen]]. #The fourth and last ability, ''Spotlight'', has the '''Producer''' begin dancing while [[The Narratorium]] dims. After 3 seconds, this created a spotlight with a radius of 14 on a random tower that applies a 75% [[Fatigue Debuff]] (42.87% increase) to any tower in it, lasting until the '''Producer''' is killed. All uses of this ability after the first one will simply move the spotlight to a different location instead of creating another spotlight. ==Logbook Description== "''The Producer initially began as a personified manifestation of Narrator's imagination — a vision of his ideal partner that existed only in his mind after finding a projector in the trash. During the Final Act, however, this imaginary partner was recreated in reality. Though, we wonder if Narrator would be different if he only knew.''" ==Appearance== The '''Producer''' is a projector turned into a representation of the [[Narrator (Enemy)|Narrator]]'s ideal partner. It has blonde hair and a black head. It wears a red dress, shoes, and jacket. On its legs, it wears white socks with black stripes and white gloves on its arms. It has white and black striped arm-bands with red straps and ribbons. She has a white and black mask with red and gold accents. ==Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[The Narratorium]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers, like the [[Accelerator]], [[Ranger]], [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Warlock]] or [[Turret]] are recommended against this [[enemy]]. **Towers like the [[Ranger]] or [[Pursuit]] can be especially useful, due to their map wide range and immunity to stuns. **The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be used to boost the statistics of your towers. **The [[Mercenary Base]] can be used to both deal damage and provide buffs to towers. *The [[Medic]] can be used to shield towers from the '''Producer's''' stuns. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Summon |- |[[File:ProducerCurtainCall.ogg]] |"''You are ruining my set!''" |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Spotlight |- |[[File:ProducerAllEyesOnMe.ogg]] |''*laugh manically*'' |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Death |- |[[File:ProducerDeath.ogg]] ||When the '''Producer''' dies |} }}}} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} ProducerWalk.gif|Walking Animation (20 December 2025 – Present) ProducerClapper.gif|''Clapboard'' Animation (20 December 2025 – Present) ProducerProjector.gif|''Beam'' Animation (20 December 2025 – Present) ProducerSummon.gif|''Summon'' Animation (20 December 2025 – Present) ProducerDance.gif|''Spotlight'' Animation (20 December 2025 – Present) ProducerDead.gif|Death Animation (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseProducer.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} TheFinalActPromoImage.png|'''Producer''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} ProducerIconIG.png|'''Producer''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Producer''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. == Update History == *'''20 December 2025''' - [[v1.83.0]] **'''Producer''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Producer's''' left eye is made out of grey plastic instead of being neon red. *'''11 February 2026''' - [[v1.85.0]] **{{Bug}} '''Producer's''' model is invisible. *'''16 February 2026''' - [[v1.85.0|v1.85.2]] **{{Bugfix}} Model is now visible. *'''11 March 2026''' - [[v1.86.0]] **'''Producer''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''8 May 2026''' - [[v1.90.0]] **{{Bug}} '''Producer's''' model is invisible. *'''22 May 2026''' - [[v1.91.0]] **{{Bugfix}} Model is now visible. {{TheNarratorium|[[Spindling]]|Wave 23|Producer|Wave 25|[[Projector]]|Wave 26}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Bosses]]
